messages.subject: Shiny Apps on IE 9
parts:
Hi,

Can we make shiny apps run on IE 9 with out installing google chrome frame plug-in?

Thanks,
Sam.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Apps on IE 9
parts:
What kind of problem are you running into with IE9?

There was a problem with in Shiny 0.6.0 where it wouldn't work properly with IE8, but it's been fixed in the development version on github. We had also heard one report of a problem with IE9 which we weren't able to reproduce ourselves, but the person who reported it said that it worked after they got the fix intended for IE8.

-Winston
